title: LAYERS OF OBSERVATION
hubHint: A signal persists inside the structure.
approachHint: The surface is transmitting. Look closer.
narration: The house does not remember in rooms. It remembers in interference: a warm window, a broken transmission, dust suspended between one image and the next. Move close enough and the surface stops being a wall. It becomes a record of everyone who paused to listen.
traceTextBody: Every repetition leaves a small difference. The house keeps those differences longer than it keeps names.
traceImageBody: A scanned fragment recovered from the inner layer.
traceVideoBody: A moving record loops where the original signal was interrupted.
rotateDevice: Please rotate the device to landscape orientation.
